proven_findings: Insert and update wrappers stage caller data in shared buffer 0x00467CA4 before entering WBTRV32!BTRCALL.
Variable-length insert/update paths clamp the record length to 0xFFF0.
The storage call is synchronous at the WGSERVER boundary and its 16-bit status is stored at 0x00467CA0.
The auxiliary status word returned through the BTRCALL argument block is stored at 0x00467CA2.
Nonzero statuses enter operation-specific Worldgroup error reporting paths.
WGSERVER exposes begin, end, abort, and unlock operations even though the recovered MajorMUD import family does not directly import the transaction exports.
No independent filesystem flush, journal rotation, checksum, or backup call is proven inside these wrappers; those behaviors remain below WBTRV32 or elsewhere in the host runtime.
corrections_to_update0028: Update0028 correctly found no transaction exports imported directly by MajorMUD, but WGSERVER itself does export _dfaBegTrans, _dfaEndTrans, and _dfaAbtTrans.
The physical mutation boundary is now bound to WBTRV32.DLL!BTRCALL rather than left generically inside Worldgroup.
